forum.title: CubeMX Version  6.18.0 error in opening/rendering UI of an old IOC project file
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@aedls ​@yucandu ​@saqlainmushtaq

The issue has been resolved in the latest STMCubeMX, version 6.18.1.

You can download the software through this link: [STM32CubeMX | Software - STMicroelectronics](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

Thanks.

Mahmoud

​

​
forum.content_text:
I have an existing IOC project originally created using **STM32CubeMX v6.6.1** with **STM32Cube Firmware Package FW\_L4 v1.17.2**. When opening this project, STM32CubeMX fails to properly render the UI (see error message below).

During this issue:

* All **Save-related menu options are disabled (greyed out)**.

* The project filename displayed in the upper-right corner includes a `*`, indicating unsaved modifications.

* When attempting to close the project or exit the application, a prompt appears to save changes, but the project **cannot actually be saved**.

Given this behavior, I would like clarification on the following:

1. Could the IOC file be **corrupted**?

2. Is this strictly a **UI rendering issue**, or something deeper (e.g., metadata or version incompatibility)?

3. What is the **likely root cause** of this error, and how can it be resolved?
